claims.location: comment[data file] / comment[technical replicate] / assay name all rows
claims.value: <deposited raw file name> / 1 (2 for the Gr08 reshoot) / file stem
claims.evidence: All 408 deposited TMT .raw files, names exactly as in PRIDE files/all, one row per documented channel; assay name = file stem shared by the channels of a run.

limitations: techsdrf is not installed; instrument, activation, collision energy and MS2 detector were read from HTTP-range raw headers of one file per run group (9 files), not from every file.

Precursor mass tolerance for the three MaxQuant searches is not recorded in the deposited parameters.txt/summary.txt; 20 ppm is the value the PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol and Supplemental Methods state ("Peptide MH+ mass tolerances were set at 20 ppm"). MaxQuant's main-search default is 4.5 ppm (first search 20 ppm), so the stated value may describe the first search.
Ancestry is not reported for any individual: characteristics[ancestry category] = not available on all rows.

Individual-level age, sex, treatment response and clinical data exist only for the 30 Table S13 patients (SWOG27 + FHCC/UW-HDR3). They were propagated by patient ID to the same patients' samples in other arms (AML1050, AML039, AML044, AML058, AML158, AML179, AML185 in the NPM1 arm); all other patients carry not available. Sex/channel concordance was checked with RPS4Y1 reporter intensity: 27/27 SWOG27 channels and 7/7 NPM1-arm overlap channels agree with Table S13 (AML179: Table S13 sex F but karyotype 46,XY[20]; RPS4Y1 is low in both of its channels, so sex female was kept).

No patient age, sex or individual-level clinical data were deposited for the SILAC-arm, NPM1-arm or E3 patients other than the S13 overlaps; the NPM1 label key gives only Age_Group (Adult/Ped), used for developmental stage (adult) and clinical data (pediatric).
SCOPE NOTE: this file covers the 408 TMT runs (SWOG27 TMT10 3x24, NPM1 TMT11 11x24 + Gr08 reshoot 24, FH/UW E2/E3 TMT11 2x24). The 228 SILAC runs are in PXD029216-silac.sdrf.tsv (rule 12).

Undocumented occupied channels left out (no source can be named): SWOG27 TMT131 in groups A, B, C (reporter signal 0.86-0.97 of the max channel; RPS4Y1 intermediate, consistent with a mixed-sex pool but not stated) and E2/E3 TMT131N/TMT131C (E2 reporter signal comparable to channels 1-9; E3 not probed - the HTTP-range read dropped). 3x24 + 2x2x24 = 168 (run, channel) pairs are therefore not annotated.

E3 plex: the FH UW45 sheet gives the 9 patients and their IP/Source/genotype but the paper does not describe this plex; its digestion (Lys-C + trypsin), reduction and alkylation are inferred from E2 (same JN092820 prep batch, same 10/15/20 acquisition, identical PD workflow).

NPM1 arm: digestion, reduction/alkylation and the cohort itself are not described in the publication (the paper reports SWOG27 and FHCC/UW-HDR3 only); technical values come from the search output and raw headers; reduction/alkylation reagents not available; second cleavage column not applicable by default.
10 NPM1-cohort channels have no deposited patient ID (8 pediatric, 2 adult); they are annotated as unidentified NPM1-mutant AML samples with individual not available.
The NPM1_Pool and Control_Pool channels are annotated as pooled samples; their member samples are not listed in any source.
Label "Molm14.L1" was read as MOLM-14 (CVCL_7916); the ".L1" suffix is unexplained.
Table S13 AML179: sex F but karyotype 46,XY[20]; proteomic RPS4Y1 supports female (kept).
reconcile raises false positives (cleavage agent wording; see validation.txt).
